### Tijuana, Mexico Destination Overview

Medical Tourism for Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico If you are thinking about going to Tijuana, Mexico, for cancer treatment, there is more to know than just the great doctors and hospitals. Tijuana is a fun and exciting city with many things to see and do. It has good food, cool places to visit, and fun activities to enjoy while you are getting better. Let’s look at some of the best things to do in Tijuana and how you can get there easily. Attractions worth Exploring Tijuana is a fun place to visit! There are lots of cool things to see and do. Walk Around : Go to Avenida Revolución! It has fun shops, yummy food, and pretty street art. It’s a great place to walk and look around. Learn and Play : Visit the Tijuana Cultural Center! You can see art, watch plays, and learn about Mexico in a big IMAX theater. Meet Wax People : The Tijuana Wax Museum has statues that look like real people! You can see famous people and learn about history in a fun way. Eat Yummy Food : Try tacos, ceviche, and churros! The food here is super tasty and will make you happy. Getting to Tijuana Made Easy By Plane San Diego International Airport (SAN) is just 25 minutes from Tijuana. Many people from the U.S., Canada, and other countries like this option. ITC even offers free rides to and from the airport. By Plane Tijuana also has its own airport, Tijuana International Airport (TIJ), with flights from many big U.S. cities.
